_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Xogador Surround na um {width}x{height} grid.
Bo é xogador {player_id}. Movimentu balidu: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' ó w/s/a/d.
Oxetivu: sobrevivi todos. Trilhu é mortal; kolision kontra parede mata; kolision frontál mata dús.

game_action.invalid_death: Jogu {player_id} móre pamodi un movimentu inválidu.

outcome.survived_win: Jogador {player_id} sobrevive; tudu kes otu pasajeru kai.
outcome.all_crashed: Tudu kes algen ki staba ta toka na kel lugar, kai tudu di un bês.
outcome.outlived: Kel jugador li vive más di ki tudu kes otu.
outcome.turn_limit: Ken ki fika más ténpu na vida ta ganha.
